newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran offers sympathies to China on Deng's death.
newsitem.headline: Iran offers sympathies to China on Deng's death.

text.p: Iran's President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani on Thursday offered his country's sympathies to China on the death of paramount leader Deng Xiaoping, the official Iranian news agency IRNA reported.
"The Chinese nation has lost a great leader and a man who was the pioneer of development in the country," Rafsanjani said in a message to Chinese President Jiang Zemin, IRNA said.
Rafsanjani said Deng played "an extraordinary role" in improving and promoting ties between Iran and China.
The two countries maintain close relations and Iran has signed contracts worth billions of dollars with China for several projects. It has also purchased missiles from Beijing.
